initial_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
submitted_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND mobility >= 71
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user wants the building near public transport. 'Near' calls for the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71. The school building itself (type, 180 sqm, energy class C or better, 14-child spring section integrated with a kindergarten) is the search subject and is not a proximity requirement.

The user requires energy class C or better, so the building must be in class A1, A2, A3, A4, B, or C. The 180 sqm gross floor area and proximity to public transport are not energy filters and are not included here.
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The 14-children capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified regulatory area threshold was provided.
